source_of_truth.base_context: Protected PR #85 is merged; T036 and T039 are checked and T034 is unchecked.

implementation_subject.meaning: This commit and tree identify the accepted T034 runtime, tests and generated public contract before evidence-only candidate metadata is added.

acceptance_matrix.proof: PublishedArticleRevision and ContentDocument defensively own immutable snapshots; JdbcPublishedArticleRepository joins only article.published_revision_id and PublicArticleApiIT rejects explicit history while proving the current pointer.

ContributorCredit is projected in persisted position order from article_contributor.article_revision_id, copied immutably, and the attributable T032 pointer test proves only selected-revision credits are returned.
ContentDocumentExtractorTest covers all 11 canonical v1 blocks, includes visible labels/captions/credits and excludes href, routing, asset, provider and generative execution metadata.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Published-article projection in content domain/application/persistence boundaries
acceptance_matrix.proof: The new content domain value objects, application port/service and JDBC adapter are used by the existing publication adapter; invalid canonical content fails closed while database failures still propagate.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Server-side plain text and deterministic reading time
acceptance_matrix.proof: The API projection now returns plainText and readingTimeMinutes derived server-side at 400 CJK characters or 200 other words per minute; boundary and integration tests pass.
PublicArticleApiIT retains published/draft/withdrawn/history/media/navigation coverage and extends the published-pointer records with exact server-derived fields.

initial_red.failure_signature: PublicArticleApiIT PathNotFoundException for the absent $.plainText field in the two attributable T032 records.

review_red.failure_signature: ContentDocumentExtractorTest proved that inserting a space between canonical inline runs changed renderer-visible text.

local_verification.java_execution: Remote Java 21/Testcontainers CI is authoritative because local Java 21 and Docker are unavailable.

live_merge_gate_contract.binding_rule: After the evidence-only candidate commit, successful CI and Security runs, browser success, mergeability and zero unresolved review threads must all bind to the observed final PR head before protected merge.

task_completion_effect: T034 is checked only as a PR candidate after every named acceptance blocker passed on the immutable implementation subject. Authoritative completion requires protected merge and main read-back.
